# Acknowledged exclusions from the release-bump tripwire (.github/scripts/check_release_bump.py).
#
# Each row records a commit that release-please silently dropped from the changelog
# and the empty re-statement commit that carried its title back into a release.
# A row suppresses ONLY the changelog-completeness failure for the original SHA —
# it never affects the version floor. Suppression applies only when the replacement
# SHA is itself present in the release PR's changelog (a completed remediation).
#
# Add entries through a human remediation PR — never by automation.
# Rows may share the same Actions run when one pre-cut audit surfaced multiple drops.
#
# Format (columns separated by two or more spaces):
#   <original-sha40>  <replacement-sha40>  <YYYY-MM-DD>  <reason>
